work.title: Triptych with Targets
work.description: Triptych-format collage spanning a wide horizontal field, populated with concentric target rings in red, black, and green, compact discs, side-view warplane drawings, and chess pieces. Three framed white rectangular panels interrupt the composition at intervals against an ochre and orange ground.
work.composition: horizontal triptych with framed white panel inserts
keywords: triptych collage with targets and warplanes
